about_the_game:
Arcane Rift is a strategic turn-based RPG set in a high-fantasy world where every decision can change the course of your adventure.

Join the Rift Guild and lead a party of heroes to explore ever-changing dungeons and uncover the secrets of the Arcane Rifts that threaten Amaram.

War of the Crowns

Amaram faces its greatest challenge.
The Amethyst Army of Throuzogard marches to seize the Crown of Wisdom and complete the Triple Crown, an artifact powerful enough to make him a god.

As a member of the Rift Guild, you are the last hope to protect the land and change the course of the war.

Draft your Builds

Recruit 10 playable characters, discover more than 50 pieces of equipment, and unlock over 50 skills to create unique combinations.

Forge new builds with every run, finding powerful synergies through the random reward system at the end of battles or special events.

Challenging Turn-Based Combat

Every decision matters in battles against Rift Guardians. Exploit their weaknesses, use buffs and debuffs at the right time, and combine abilities to turn the tide of combat.
Mastering each creature’s weaknesses is essential to securing victory against the Amethyst Army.

Dynamic Maps

No adventure is ever the same.
Each run generates unique maps, filled with random events and choices that shape your journey. Perhaps you’ll even find new allies along the way.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS (64-bit) or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3220 / AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2 compatible card (Intel HD 4000 / GTX 750 / R7 250X)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64-bit) or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 560 or better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.12 (Monterey) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2012+)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or Apple M1 integrated GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 (Monterey) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 / Intel Core i5 (2017+)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 / AMD Radeon Pro 560 or better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
